summary.text: Sign in to your CPF Healthcare dashboard and follow the steps to view claim details from the past 15 months.

details.heading: Claims older than 15 months
details.body: To view details of claims prior to the past 15 months, submit a request to the Central Provident Fund Board via www.cpf.gov.sg/eSvc/Web/FeedbackSubscription/Index.

steps.name: Sign in
steps.text: Go to www.cpf.gov.sg and sign in to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass.

items: Sign in to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass.

steps.name: Open the claims page
steps.text: Go to “Latest healthcare payments and claims”.

items: Go to “Latest healthcare payments and claims”.

steps.name: Select the hospitalisation period
steps.text: Choose the hospitalisation period for the claim.

items: Choose the hospitalisation period for the claim.

steps.name: Open the claim details
steps.text: Tap the amount at MediSave Payment or MediShield Life/Integrated Shield Plan Payment to view the details.

items: Tap the amount at MediSave Payment or MediShield Life/Integrated Shield Plan Payment.

How do I check my MediShield Life claim details?
Where can I see my MediSave and MediShield Life claims?

sources.page_title: How do I view details of my MediShield Life claims from the online MediSave and/or MediShield Life Claim Statements?

quotes.text: You can view the details of your MediSave withdrawals and MediShield Life claim details for past 15 months online at www.cpf.gov.sg under "Latest healthcare payments and claims".
Login to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass
Proceed to “Latest healthcare payments and claims”
Click on the amount at MediSave Payment or MediShield Life/Integrated Shield Plan Payment to view the claim details.
If you would like to view the details of claims prior to the past 15 months, please submit a request to the Central Provident Fund Board via www.cpf.gov.sg/eSvc/Web/FeedbackSubscription/Index .
